Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 141, "heading": "III MÈRE INNOCENTE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u141-r0062", "target": "— Как бы не так!", "source_sha256": "c27ca058e946d65c1e1c4190d27a9850ae479eb67f326d51044d7e2523528e15", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u141-r0062", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "692d7a869412bafe5f55b364ae61d68197cc17ccbe94f6f097cef55eaaf74b82"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u141-r0063", "target": "— Что вы говорите?", "source_sha256": "d2c2f2d794c52e00130081a51a79c13c62fe48a35befffe865662c7522916245", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u141-r0063", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "40f69e3a0b18275e0c9e4657ad46600eb21dbebf6ca7fdb31dceddb174e13056"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 2, "book": 8, "chapter": 3, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u141-r0064", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je dis plus souvent.", "sha256": "382e156abfba78f997468eb54d1222689af407607a58697937bb77e86f6de7dc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0065", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Plus souvent que quoi ?", "sha256": "d3dd3468b78828262fd8fcbfe1d5bb869d6053d1b3e2942c267957eb1bc19db0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0066", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Révérende mère, je ne dis pas plus souvent que quoi, je dis plus souvent.", "sha256": "c57f73e24be2063d296ad587d14a332f32beec99f1accd452db45a09eb94ce0d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0067", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne vous comprends pas. Pourquoi dites-vous plus souvent ?", "sha256": "2d419027606845ade62759455bcee89eb3c1c9b048194abe908581743ef35db7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0068", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pour dire comme vous, révérende mère.", "sha256": "31e0f17730b7e03c9ddaacef55e0eb9f0470c82b70ece6ece11b0dd459c72ddc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0069", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais je n’ai pas dit plus souvent.", "sha256": "8b5dfd122e3c3e048fe88969c0813c2b94e2891f7a99426d1abff1e7618dfdb8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0070", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous ne l’avez pas dit, mais je l’ai dit pour dire comme vous.", "sha256": "40d8a3be0078cf7b462a55ec4eac7f67feaf0204e4fa35de80554401e61b5ec6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0071", "tag": "prose", "text": "En ce moment neuf heures sonnèrent.", "sha256": "69db73c10c9c8eb59e69ad83e4a6818f1ace5f2d77d0ea3b459fd076f9f6eb62", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0072", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À neuf heures du matin et à toute heure loué soit et adoré le très Saint-Sacrement de l’autel, dit la prieure.", "sha256": "041fe9d54e3677a7336ffb610db88454a0037ed64f38edd813298e3a46233bd6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0073", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Amen, dit Fauchelevent.", "sha256": "c6b7ae11c2ffdcbfa548ee0e6696c384a7c2319f40fe76630dc7d452ccc80398", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0074", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’heure sonna à propos. Elle coupa court à Plus Souvent. Il est probable que sans elle la prieure et Fauchelevent ne se fussent jamais tirés de cet écheveau.", "sha256": "f937d214f491fa31977a48f79a53eb40ccf57c21b3e6ae85648a0013be719c5d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0075", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent s’essuya le front.", "sha256": "4512f4650f6e915770eba06f5ff274c203ee775039ee418504588bf16dffcd5d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0076", "tag": "prose", "text": "La prieure fit un nouveau petit murmure intérieur, probablement sacré, puis haussa la voix.", "sha256": "742bbaec98ba83acb64636726c5df7f7102dbb93e9135892c142f1f14924b448", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0077", "tag": "prose", "text": "— De son vivant, mère Crucifixion faisait des conversions ; après sa mort, elle fera des miracles.", "sha256": "033b9eebac90cc13f14074f2465e9cf4d3792b081d54218f0f709c6e0657d144", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0078", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Elle en fera ! répondit Fauchelevent emboîtant le pas, et faisant effort pour ne plus broncher désormais.", "sha256": "5755056bde7624e4fe6fe66454e8204056ad72c3991a7caf4396114c5c2da1bb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0079", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Père Fauvent, la communauté a été bénie en la mère Crucifixion. Sans doute il n’est point donné à tout le monde de mourir comme le cardinal de Bérulle en disant la sainte messe, et d’exhaler son âme vers Dieu en prononçant ces paroles : [[I]]Hanc igitur oblationem[[/I]]. Mais, sans atteindre à tant de bonheur, la mère Crucifixion a eu une mort très précieuse. Elle a eu sa connaissance jusqu’au dernier instant. Elle nous parlait, puis elle parlait aux anges. Elle nous a fait ses derniers commandements. Si vous aviez un peu plus de foi, et si vous aviez pu être dans sa cellule, elle vous aurait guéri votre jambe en y touchant. Elle souriait. On sentait qu’elle ressuscitait en Dieu. Il y a eu du paradis dans cette mort-là.", "sha256": "d00894dd9d30086bc312a81392c03e3f02908b99635e0c2685289c1657c42214", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0080", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent crut que c’était une oraison qui finissait.", "sha256": "c76c31559976eedd456315e4ec055d3b657e94c4e5a61698c6511df063dc5f26", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0081", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Amen, dit-il.", "sha256": "b4c1f008bd19449618bd5e46d75e28f68753f577ae89ce84629d47cbc6a52c0f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0082", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Père Fauvent, il faut faire ce que veulent les morts.", "sha256": "94903df19747d1c0d30a91206bc3e4101b20e606e1f7a08a3e2e831982c5f860", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0083", "tag": "prose", "text": "La prieure dévida quelques grains de son chapelet. Fauchelevent se taisait. Elle poursuivit :", "sha256": "70d0cbf19c3fc6d4c44f3759ffcc513a724d21d4f9c224cacd282fb7555953f2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0084", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’ai consulté sur cette question plusieurs ecclésiastiques travaillant en Notre-Seigneur qui s’occupent dans l’exercice de la vie cléricale et qui font un fruit admirable.", "sha256": "02894d3a0e100aad2d419750217d3336c1a9e02d46b2c77fff827b46618fea44", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0085", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Révérende mère, on entend bien mieux le glas d’ici que dans le jardin.", "sha256": "a9b0794093fb1b36fdf05b3824aeb1616e6df91803b9dec0166e1485cca218fe", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0086", "tag": "prose", "text": "— D’ailleurs, c’est plus qu’une morte, c’est une sainte.", "sha256": "8a8bdb5b39a8c0a93b85ba547f915ac7bfe7dde619133a7f3b1cf5429bbcb96c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0087", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comme vous, révérende mère.", "sha256": "3404f6e9b81b4c40930d9c9335d4b332b0e91e82326b85b46f8ab2322d1d0410", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0088", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Elle couchait dans son cercueil depuis vingt ans, par permission expresse de notre saint-père Pie VII.", "sha256": "bd09f940b133de7ad31109dbc72eb45519c25b2dfe69b9a891c12d438696bb6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0089", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Celui qui a couronné l’emp… Buonaparte.", "sha256": "1c2b9d8c37881df8b02845da546eac93bd6229ede068f1496f6e886dea19d244", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0090", "tag": "prose", "text": "Pour un habile homme comme Fauchelevent, le souvenir était malencontreux. Heureusement la prieure, toute à sa pensée, ne l’entendit pas. Elle continua :", "sha256": "8490cc5cb9c15c2ea1f2f291e121e807aaa2164c6620d8fd72bfa3cd2929c0e9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0091", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Père Fauvent ?", "sha256": "ef876e3b0db43f30be3291a19499ad6f422f7a11ce87a01c58ec5cc66e65befc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0092", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Révérende mère ?", "sha256": "4f8717cde34eb9fc4ae1dede759586e0113b4b82498701bc688428ecdb412e46", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0093", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Saint Diodore, archevêque de Cappadoce, voulut qu’on écrivît sur sa sépulture ce seul mot : [[I]]Acarus[[/I]], qui signifie ver de terre ; cela fut fait. Est-ce vrai ?", "sha256": "0cba3dbda1577a38eb9a961605e5d1db2139b5d8c9a88f351dea696884a6d8e0", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0094", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, révérende mère.", "sha256": "93a8c97ab452f878a8ecae79d6f9682801ff41d0c4e401f5cdeefca57652c687", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u141-r0095", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le bienheureux Mezzocane, abbé d’Aquila, voulut être inhumé sous la potence ; cela fut fait.", "sha256": "27def6ca9d6e86a81e9d67d5e4b5c982d7b432030db251328899ae2a390041ea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
